pedido.description: overworld map of a fantasy island for a 16-bit SNES JRPG, seen from above, bright cheerful colors, deep blue ocean with small white wave crests, sandy beaches all around the coast, a dense green forest and meadows in the south, a blue lake with reeds in the east, dry orange badlands with cactus and a big volcano with glowing lava in the north of the island, a pale dirt trail linking four small clearings, and in the far north of the map an unexplored land completely hidden under a thick bank of white clouds and fog, clean detailed pixel art, no text, no letters, no characters, no interface
